newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie Oct same store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie Oct same store sales down.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday same store sales for the four weeks ended November 2 declined 7.2 percent.
Total sales for that period were off 3.1 percent to $89.3 million from $92.1 million.
Carson said year-to-date same store sales rose 2.6 percent, while total sales for that period gained 4.9 percent to $728.0 million from $694.0 million.
Carson said that 1995 year-to-date sales exclude $25.0 million of sales from eight stores that were sold.

"A shift in the promotional calendar, which helped produce a 15 percent comparable store sales increase in September, impacted October sales negatively," Stanton Bluestone, chairman, said in a statement.
On a combined basis, September and October produced a 3.7 percent comparable store sales increase and a 7.4 percent total sales increase.
"Our strongest business categories continue to be men's and women's apparel, cosmetics and furniture," Bluestone said.
